lines.text: The apostles return and report to Jesus, and He takes them away privately to a town called Bethsaida.
The crowds follow Jesus, and He welcomes them, speaks about the kingdom of God, and heals the sick.
As the day ends, the Twelve ask Jesus to dismiss the crowd, but He says to give them something to eat.
They have only seven loaves and two fish, and Jesus has about five thousand men sit down in groups of about fifty.
Jesus blesses and breaks the loaves and fish, they all eat, and the disciples gather seven basketfuls of leftovers.
